transactions.sale_price_citation: p6008: 'the Manager announced the divestment of Plaza on 20 February 2025 for US$51.8 million less seller credits, and the property was classified as asset held for sale in the Group's statement of financial position as at 31 December 2024 at the carrying amount of US$43.7 million.'
transactions.notes: Gross sale price US$51.8m (Secaucus, New Jersey), announced 2025-02-20. Derived vs_valuation = (51,800,000 - 43,700,000)/43,700,000 = +18.54%. Alternative vs_book (net proceeds US$40.0m vs carrying US$43.7m) = -8.47% -- record the gross-consideration/independent-valuation basis per spec's 'capture gross consideration' rule (Rule 7); net proceeds after disposal costs given separately. Accounting loss on disposal is disclosed only COMBINED for Plaza+Peachtree (US$3.323m loss, Distribution Statement Note A / Statement of Comprehensive Income, p101/p104) -- not split per property, so no per-property accounting gain/loss field populated.
